text:
frank_fin: Heads-up: Auriga Systems (acct AG-2510) flagged by collections. 2 invoices overdue totalling $41,200, oldest 49 days. Collections vendor says clients bank put a temporary hold after a chargeback and they want to submit ACH from a new treasury account. Theyre disputing a $1,100 usage charge on INV-20240805 and warned they'll involve counsel if pushed. @leah_support @mina_sales can you triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240705 ($18,600), INV-20240805 ($22,600). Last payment recorded: $2,000 on 2024-06-10. Status: PAST_DUE. Collections vendor: Harbor Collections outreach started 2024-09-20.

oscar_collections: Calls are going to voicemail. Recommend brief hold while finance/sales attempt resolution; otherwise resume standard dunning. Need a clear closure date.

leah_support: I can offer a 30-minute portal unlock for ACH entry once we verify bank docs. Workflow: open ticket, run KYC + fraud checks, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=AG-2510 --minutes=30 --by=leah_support`. Uploads must go to secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (no channel DMs).

mina_sales: I'd propose we credit the disputed $1,100 as a one-time goodwill to avoid counsel and ask for 50% payment now and 50% in 30 days. I'll take the negotiation if finance signs off.

frank_fin: Policy reminder: ops can approve provisional credits up to $2,000. Anything above goes to CFO. We should still log disputed amounts in GL under MR-AR-DISPUTE.

cora_cfo: Quick call: approve provisional credit of $1,100 to close the dispute and authorize a 30-minute unlock after KYC docs verified. Conditions: 1) client uploads bank letter + voided check OR completes micro-deposit verification during the window; 2) client signs a 14-day reconciliation and payment commitment; 3) pause collections outreach until 2024-09-28 COB. Add account note: "PROV_CREDIT_1100_CORA_2024-09-21". No ongoing payment plans without exec sign-off for AR > $40k.

leah_support: Creating ticket SB-99544 and will run fraud/KYC checks. Will attach verification logs. Standing by to run `/unlock-portal` after docs validated.

mina_sales: I'll email the client now with the offer (credit + 50/50 split) and request uploads to the intake link. CC collections & finance.

oscar_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-09-28 COB. If we don't have signed ack/payment by then, resume escalation on 2024-09-29.

frank_fin: I'll prepare the provisional credit journal and tag AR with MR-AR-PROV once we have the signed doc. Update SB-99544 when payments land. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
